svg.title: Asil Türkmen, software engineering, North Cyprus. A lighthouse beam sweeps over the night sea and lights up the name. I'm Asil Türkmen, a Software Engineering student at Eastern Mediterranean University in North Cyprus. I work on web apps, APIs, automation and games. Selected work: NedirBeo: A community dictionary for Cypriot Turkish; Wipeout: A multiplayer parkour game played over LAN by 50+ people at an event; HesAppcım: An app for tracking shared expenses and calculating who owes whom; Yayla Yemek Evi: The website of a village restaurant in Pamuklu, North Cyprus. Tools I use: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vue 3, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Laravel, Python, Flask, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Unity, C#, Docker, Git, Vercel. Dawn breaks over the sea: more about my work at asilturkmen.com.
